verdict.rationale: Docs confirm order lifecycle tracking exists for agent checkouts — agents can poll an order until it reaches a terminal state, and card-based order intents track total/reserved/spent/available amounts — but the agent-checkout flow explicitly lacks webhooks in v1 ('no webhooks in v1... you poll until it reaches a terminal state') and has no staging environment for testing. General order/payment webhooks (crossmint-docs-18) exist for standard Checkout, not confirmed for agent checkouts specifically. missing for 10: real-time push notifications/webhooks for agent-initiated orders, a documented status/tracking API endpoint schema, and independent confirmation the polling mechanism works reliably in production.
